name: Ball smashes text
what: A chunky glowing word is typed in letter by letter while a ball flies in from the left and floats above it; the ball is thrown up and to the side, winds up, then dives through the word, which bursts into wedge-shaped pieces that fly outward and fall out of the frame.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f2-f19 the word is typed in, a letter about every 2 frames; f16-f49 the ball flies in from the left edge and settles above the word's left end; f31-f40 the word shrinks 9 %; f53-f67 the ball is thrown up and right and rests; f58-f79 the word squeezes taller and narrower; f69-f79 the ball winds up and dives; f80 it hits the word, which bursts into wedge pieces (f81-f103) that fly outward at a steady speed and fall (gravity); the ball leaves at the bottom right (f86); empty again to f119
